name: La Mongie
description: La Mongie is the modern, purpose-built eastern base of the Grand Tourmalet (shared with Barèges). 100km of pistes (54 runs: 12 green, 23 blue, 15 red, 4 black), 30 lifts including 3 cable cars. The Pic du Midi cable car (15min) takes you to 2,877m for a 360° panorama of the Pyrenees, a museum, planetarium, and the Pontoon in the Sky — a 12m glass walkway over a 1,000m drop. La Grenouillère square is the lively centre. Ice tyrolienne zip line over frozen waterfalls. Snowmobile tours on the Col du Tourmalet at sunset. Ice climbing on the Pic du Midi north face. 6 altitude restaurants. 2 balneotherapy centres. Livelier atmosphere and better snow record than Barèges.

overview.atmosphere: Eastern gateway to Grand Tourmalet — largest ski domain in the French Pyrenees (100km). Purpose-built resort at 1,800m with direct piste access. Pic du Midi cable car (2,877m) with panoramic terrace, planetarium, and glass walkway over 1,000m void.

beyond_skiing.snowmobiling: Guided tours on the Col du Tourmalet at sunset.
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Ice waterfall on Pic du Midi north face. Guided by mountain guides. 1,000m of emptiness beneath.. Dog sledding, snowshoeing, paragliding, 6 altitude restaurants, free resort shuttle, shuttle to Bagnères-de-Bigorre.

honest_drawbacks: Purpose-built architecture — less charm than Barèges
Can feel crowded at peak times
Limited non-ski activities compared to larger Alps resorts
Weather-dependent — high winds close Pic du Midi cable car
